problem_restatement.input: V58 BTC has two short routes but its only long route requires an hourly downside sweep and reclaim. Forty-five unique V58 hourly decisions produced zero eligible BTC longs because no required sweep occurred. Prior completed-bar, cross-asset, funding, OI, and one-minute terminal-order-flow challengers were rejected.
problem_restatement.output: Test one materially different BTC-only long mechanism using the within-event sequence of aggressive selling, limited price impact, bid-depth depletion, and bid replenishment over a completed ten-second bucket.
problem_restatement.constraint: No live strategy, risk, route, position, process, or configuration mutation; no parameter grid; no outcome inspection before this contract.
problem_restatement.success_criterion: Determine whether the exact event has stable positive after-cost value and useful cadence across fixed validation partitions, and whether its L2 absorption conditions add value over an otherwise identical extreme-sell/uptrend control.

hypothesis: During an established BTC one-hour uptrend, a very large aggressive sell burst that produces limited midpoint decline while displayed bid depth depletes and then substantially replenishes may identify passive demand absorbing forced or impatient selling, followed by bullish continuation.
claim_boundaries: Displayed depth can cancel or reappear without executing; replenishment is not proof of one persistent buyer.
Aggressor-side classification and archived book snapshots are vendor-derived historical observations, not private matching-engine queue state.
Historical midpoint and public-trade stop proxies are not Hyperliquid mark price and cannot reproduce the exact live protective-stop trigger.
Outcome-blind input profiling established cadence only; it did not establish return prediction or profitability.
All historical partitions have been opened by prior project research, so project-level multiple testing remains material.

mechanism_novelty.claim: No prior project artifact found before preregistration tests this exact BTC-only ten-second sequence of sell notional, sell share, within-bucket midpoint resistance, bid-depth depletion, bid-depth replenishment, terminal top-ten imbalance, spread quality, and prior one-hour trend.
closest_rejected_families: BTC and SOL five-minute flow-exhaustion reversion using a completed price shock, aggregate flow, final-60-second flow reversal, and one terminal book imbalance
BTC and SOL one-minute order-flow impulse continuation and reversion using aggregate or terminal low-timeframe features
BTC five-minute L2 Ridge and LightGBM expected-return screens
completed-bar BTC pullback, breakout, sweep-relaxation, EMA-speed, breadth, and spot-lead variants
mechanism_novelty.material_difference: This candidate is long-only and path-dependent inside one completed ten-second event. It requires displayed bid depth to deplete and recover while heavy aggressive selling fails to move midpoint materially. It is not a completed one-minute or five-minute shock reversal, terminal snapshot filter, HYPE strategy transfer, or threshold rescue of a rejected bar strategy.
mechanism_novelty.falsifier: An exact preexisting implementation/result with the same event identity invalidates novelty. Negative or unstable after-cost evidence rejects the economic hypothesis.

inspected_fields: first, minimum, and last top-ten bid depth
explicitly_not_inspected: future BTC returns after candidate events
candidate target, stop, or maximum-hold outcomes
candidate win rate, profit factor, drawdown, or PnL
outcome_blind_feature_feasibility.threshold_provenance: Rounded before outcome inspection from the approximate 99.5th percentile of development-period ten-second sell notional. The static value replaces the nondeterministic approximate-quantile result.
outcome_blind_feature_feasibility.interpretation: Adequate raw event feasibility to justify one frozen experiment; no profitability inference.

frozen_market_contract.book_source: deduplicated Hyperliquid historical L2 snapshots imported from verified 0xarchive bundles
frozen_market_contract.trade_source: deduplicated Hyperliquid public trades imported from verified 0xarchive bundles
frozen_market_contract.archive_gap_rule: reject any event or lifecycle requiring an uncovered source interval; never fill missing L2 with a success-shaped fallback

frozen_signal_contract.prior_60m_trend_definition: bucket_last_mid relative to the latest complete one-minute public-trade close causally available at or before bucket_start_minus_60_minutes; anchor age may not exceed sixty seconds
frozen_signal_contract.cooldown_semantics: chronological greedy selection; after an emitted event no new event may emit before event_available_time_plus_60_minutes

frozen_control_contract.definition: Same symbol, ten-second bucket, minimum snapshots, $5.5M sell notional, 75% sell share, prior-60-minute uptrend, one-hour cooldown, entry, exit, funding, friction, and capacity contract, but without midpoint-impact, bid-depletion, bid-recovery, terminal-imbalance, or spread predicates.
frozen_control_contract.purpose: Test whether the L2 absorption sequence adds selection value beyond a large sell burst during an uptrend.

frozen_execution_and_risk_contract.entry_capacity: full visible ask-depth VWAP required; incomplete capacity rejects the attempt

frozen_friction_and_funding_contract.entry_price: next eligible visible-depth ask VWAP after scenario latency plus declared adverse slippage
frozen_friction_and_funding_contract.target_fill_price: fixed target price after archived best bid reaches or exceeds target
frozen_friction_and_funding_contract.stop_and_time_exit_price: next eligible visible-depth bid VWAP after trigger or deadline
frozen_friction_and_funding_contract.funding_cashflow: exact ordered Hyperliquid hourly funding rows with long-side sign
frozen_friction_and_funding_contract.queue_limitation: target maker queue position is unobserved; best-bid crossing is a fill proxy rather than an actual fill claim

partition_disclosure: All partitions were opened by earlier project research. This exact mechanism and thresholds were frozen before its own forward outcomes, but the evidence remains retrospective and exposed to multiple testing.

archive_source_evidence.identity_method: SHA-256 over ordered archive_bundles rows containing bundle_id, bounds, depth, row counts, both manifest hashes, and bundle fingerprint

acceptance_and_disposition_contract.trial_abort_policy: Only a technical integrity failure aborts publication. Losing, sparse, high-drawdown, or zero-trade outcomes remain reportable results.
acceptance_and_disposition_contract.cadence_requirement_basis: Thirteen completed trades per ninety-day partition approximates one useful opportunity per week and is a declared usefulness criterion, not an abort gate.
acceptance_and_disposition_contract.if_any_support_requirement_fails: reject this exact candidate without threshold, side, horizon, or exit retuning
live_proposal_requires_additionally: prospective post-preregistration ten-second feature and signal capture
live-provider parity for event boundaries, trade deduplication, and visible-depth entry
exact Hyperliquid mark and protective-stop reconciliation
shared one-BTC-position interaction against the unchanged V58 BTC routes
fresh stop-wave and portfolio drawdown stress
verified flat and order-free cutover boundary

uncertainties_risks_and_failure_modes: The static $5.5M threshold came from one development distribution and may drift with BTC price, volatility, and market participation.
Displayed bid replenishment may be cancel-replace behavior rather than durable absorption.
The ten-second event may be too slow for the informational edge or too fast for archived snapshot resolution.
Entry spread, taker fee, target fee, funding, and adverse latency may consume the continuation move.
Development has 386 empty hourly book bundles and pseudo-holdout has 21; incomplete intervals can reduce usable samples or bias naive analyses.
Historical target queue position and live mark-trigger behavior are not reconstructable exactly.
The control has a different event count, so total PnL is not an isolated measure of L2 selection value; expectancy and matched overlap must also be reported.
A positive standalone result may still reduce shared-portfolio return by overlapping stronger BTC routes or occupying capital at the wrong time.
Repeated project research on the same archive raises false-discovery risk even with this experiment-level preregistration.
validation_plan: Unit-test causal boundaries, deduplication, every threshold, cooldown, gaps, capacity, fees, funding, exit precedence, and immutable publication.
Fail closed on source identity drift, schema drift, missing funding, uncovered L2, or incomplete lifecycle evidence.
Publish all arms, partitions, scenarios, blockers, and rejected attempts.
Require byte-identical rerun before interpreting the outcome.
Reconcile the active V58 runtime before and after the experiment and confirm no live mutation.
falsifier: Negative, non-robust, overly concentrated, too-sparse, or control-inferior after-cost validation evidence rejects this exact mechanism. Source, causality, capacity, funding, or lifecycle inconsistency invalidates the result until corrected and rerun.
